fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant returned to the residence near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony and found the door forced open, with a television and a music system missing. The matter was brought to Erode South PS on 2026-05-27, while the incident was placed on 2026-05-27 at about 20:00. The online submission was made by Eswari Sri (9000000024). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Mohan Sekar, using the number 9000000168. Vignesh Babu (9000000271), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly targeted the house while the family was away.
fields.Keywords: burglary, house break-in, CCTV, residential colony, associate, suspect, mobile number, photograph
